2.text: “Ba unyoroheye gato maze nkwereke,Kuko ngifite icyo mvugira Imana.

3.text: Ndazana ubwenge bwanjye mbukuye kure,Kandi ndātūrira Umuremyi wanjye uburyo akiranuka.

4.text: Ni ukuri ibyo mvuga ntabwo ari ibinyoma,Umuntu ufite ubwenge butunganye ari kumwe nawe.

5.text: “Dore Imana irakomeye kandi ntigira uwo ihinyura,Irakomeye mu mbaraga no mu bwenge.

7.text: Ntabwo ivana amaso yayo ku bakiranutsi,Ahubwo ibicaza hamwe n'abami ku ntebe zabo,Ikabakomeza iteka ryose bagashyirwa hejuru.

8.text: Kandi iyo baboheshejwe iminyururu,Bagafatishwa ingoyi z'umubabaro,

9.text: Ibereka imirimo yabo n'ibicumuro byabo,Uko bagenje bibona.

10.text: Kandi izibura amatwi yabo ngo bumve ibyigisho,Ikabihanangiriza kuva mu byaha.

11.text: Nibayumvira bakayikorera,Bazamara iminsi yabo baguwe neza,Bazamara n'imyaka yabo mu byishimo.

12.text: Ariko nibatumvira bazarimbuzwa inkota,Kandi bazapfa ari nta bwenge bafite.

13.text: “Kandi abatubaha Imana mu mitima yabo bibikira uburakari,Iyo ibaboshye ntibarushya batabaza.

14.text: Bapfa bakenyutse,Kandi ubugingo bwabo buherera mu banduye.

15.text: Irokora abarengana ikabakura mu makuba,Kandi akarengane gatuma ibaziburira amatwi.

16.text: “Ni ukuri iba yaragukuye mu makuba,Ikagushyira ahagari hadafunganye,Kandi ibishyizwe ku meza yawe,Biba byuzuwemo n'ibinure.

17.text: Ariko wuzuwemo n'imanza z'abanyabyaha,Urubanza no gukiranuka biragufashe.

18.text: Hariho uburakari.Wirinde utayobeshwa no kwirarira kwawe,Bigatuma incungu nyinshi zinanirwa kugucungura.

19.text: Mbese ubutunzi bwawe n'ububasha bw'imbaraga zawe bwose,Byatuma utabona amakuba?

20.text: Ntukifuze ijoro,Igihe abantu bacibwa bakava iwabo.

21.text: Itonde we kwibwira ibyo gukiranirwa,Kuko ari byo wahisemo bikakurutira umubabaro ufite.

22.text: “Dore Imana ikoresha ibikomeye ububasha bwayo,Umwigisha uhwanye na yo ni nde?

23.text: Ni nde wayitegekeye inzira zayo?Cyangwa ni nde wavuga ati‘Wakoze ikitaboneye’?

24.text: Ibuka gushimisha imirimo yayo,N'ibyayo abantu baririmbaga.

25.text: Bose barayirebaga,Umuntu ayitegereza ari kure yayo.

26.text: Dore Imana irakomeye kandi ntituyizi,Imibare y'imyaka yayo ntibarika.

27.text: “Kuko izamura amazi akaba igicu,Kigahinduka imvura itonyanga,

28.text: Maze ibicu bikayigusha,Ikagwa mu gihugu ari nyinshi.

29.text: Mbese hari uwabasha kumenya uko ibicu bikwira hose,Akamenya n'uko imihindaganyo iva mu ihema ryayo?

30.text: Dore yigotesha umucyo,Kandi itwikīra no mu kuzimu kw'inyanja.

31.text: Kuko ibyo ari ibyo ikirisha urubanza rw'amahanga,Kandi itanga ibyokurya byinshi.

32.text: Ihisha umurabyo mu maboko yayo,Maze ikawutegeka guhamya intego.

33.text: Guhinda kw'inkuba kugaragaza ibyayo,Amatungo na yo akamenya yuko umugaru uhinduye.
